$comment: Provenance for the source tree in this repository. Every file outside the
repo_meta.hand_authored list below is a verbatim copy of the named commit in
the producing repository; those mirrored files are not hand-maintained, and
corrections to them are made upstream and re-mirrored, never edited in place.
The hand_authored list is the exception, and it is machine-readable on
purpose: a republish MUST preserve those paths rather than replacing the tree

standalone_build.command: npm install && npm run build && npm test
standalone_build.known_failures: the four real-binary arms in test/muse-serve-child.test.ts and test/spawn-handshake.test.ts spawn the Rust 'tbh serve' host, which is not part of this closure

note: Owner ruling, session 2026-08-31: 'The license for the sdk will provisionally
be the MIT license.' Provisional means MIT applies to the source as published
here, but the licensing review has not formally concluded.
The package.json 'license' field is NOT set from this repository: package.json
and clients/*/package.json are closure_paths entries, so the field is set
upstream in mslsrc/tbh and arrives by mirror.

rationale: These are repository-meta files that have no upstream counterpart: they
describe or govern THIS repository rather than the mirrored artifact, so
there is no upstream source to mirror them from. They are the sanctioned
hand-authored exception to the mirror doctrine, not drift.
A publisher that force-pushes or otherwise replaces the tree wholesale will
delete them silently and still report success. That failure mode is real and
has been observed on the gh-pages branch of this repository (mslsrc/tbh
